content: ReadReportingRevisionsPost (POST _apis/wit/reporting/workitemrevisions): filter only by fields, types, includeDeleted/IdentityRef/TagRef/LatestOnly; no filter by ID, iteration or area. Query params continuationToken (watermark) and startDateTime (mutually exclusive). Page until isLastBatch true; values untyped (*[]interface{} in Go SDK). Project-scoped via route; omitting project is org-wide. startDateTime only yields revisions after the date, so it cannot by itself give a field value at a baseline instant.
